---
title: "Taxonomy preranked GSEA by DFS risk group"
output: html_notebook
---

**fgsea** preranked GSEA on Taxonomy limma High vs Low DE results — same method as Stage 2, Retrospective, and Colossus.

**Input:** `analysis_output/taxonomy/Taxonomy_limma_high_vs_low_all_genes.csv`

**Outputs:** `analysis_output/taxonomy/Taxonomy_fgsea_hallmark_*.csv`, KEGG tables, dot plots.

**R environment:** `/work_space/envs/transcriptomics2/bin/R`

```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```

```{r load-data}
if (file.exists("analysis_output/taxonomy/Taxonomy_limma_high_vs_low_all_genes.csv")) {
  base_dir <- "."
} else if (file.exists("Transcriptomics/analysis_output/taxonomy/Taxonomy_limma_high_vs_low_all_genes.csv")) {
  base_dir <- "Transcriptomics"
} else {
  stop("Knit from Transcriptomics/ or its parent directory.")
}

source(file.path(base_dir, "analysis_helpers.R"))
source(file.path(base_dir, "gsea_helpers.R"))
dirs <- setup_analysis_dirs(base_dir, "taxonomy")
output_dir <- dirs$output_dir

limma_csv <- file.path(output_dir, "Taxonomy_limma_high_vs_low_all_genes.csv")
if (!file.exists(limma_csv)) {
  stop("Run Taxonomy_limma_de_by_risk_group.Rmd first: ", limma_csv)
}
```

```{r run-gsea}
gsea_out <- run_gsea_from_limma_csv(
  limma_csv    = limma_csv,
  output_dir   = output_dir,
  file_prefix  = "Taxonomy",
  cohort_title = "Taxonomy RNA-Seq",
  collections  = c("hallmark", "kegg")
)

sig_h <- gsea_out$hallmark %>% filter(padj < 0.05)
cat("\nHallmark pathways FDR < 0.05:", nrow(sig_h), "\n")
if (nrow(sig_h) > 0) {
  print(sig_h %>% select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>% head(15))
}

sig_k <- gsea_out$kegg %>% filter(padj < 0.05)
cat("\nKEGG pathways FDR < 0.05:", nrow(sig_k), "\n")
if (nrow(sig_k) > 0) {
  print(sig_k %>% select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size) %>% head(15))
}
```
